test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the pair which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two set of pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

FJK : KOP

MQR : RVW
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: (5) is added to the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

Given :​​

FJK : KOP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85f622a6465ebf47b8ea5f992ee5a45853e3ba18b14cd6dbff8b763063bab2c7.png] 

And,

MQR : RVW​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fc6b0c48aad0b93b542cd68365dbc6188274ea1b2dd6c20c0a8d6476db8f9bb.png] 

So, Checking the options one by one :

Option - (1): GMN : FLM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06928b140e4ebb7c9efdee45ad0b9e958bd14797658218c8ba50d0673d9bd9e8.png] 

Option - (2): JMP : ORU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e00bf805c587f1c360d118294288addc750297a192e7b14080f050f30e0d0722.png] 

Option - (3): ADE : ZWV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a64266f454d3195488704ee551dc252c3a481b33e3f73b545ef86299dfa53d8d.png] 

Option - (4): PRS : SRP

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b09aed9f7cead34ef0d4f90bcd69bb58c370cddcc48d9176b263fecb76982830.png] 

Thus, out of all the options "JMP : ORU" follows the same pattern as given.

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.

89:T10
